text: Approachable means easy to talk to. You do not feel shy. This author writes like a friend telling a fun story.
Intimidating means it makes you feel small or a little scared. It seems big or hard. The author felt this because so many fans love the books.
To brainstorm is to think up lots of ideas. You do not stop to pick the best one yet.
A kid reporter is a young person who writes news stories for a magazine. Shaiyar is one for TIME for Kids.
Comic Con is a big yearly show in New York City. Fans meet authors and artists. They dress up and talk about comics, books, and movies.
The Javits Center is a huge building in New York City. Big shows are held there.
Pop culture means the movies, shows, books, and games that lots of people love.
To cosplay is to dress up as a character from a book, show, or movie.
A onesie is a one-piece outfit for a baby.
Superman is a comic book hero. He can fly and he is very strong.
A celebration is a happy time to enjoy something special, like a party.
Dipper is a boy who solves mysteries in the cartoon Gravity Falls.
Gravity Falls is a cartoon about twins who spend a summer in a strange town.
Hunter is a character in the cartoon The Owl House.
The Owl House is a cartoon about a girl who finds a magic world.
Miles Morales is a kid who becomes Spider-Man in comics and movies.
Percy Jackson is a boy hero in a book series. He is the son of a Greek god.
Rick Riordan is the author who wrote the Percy Jackson books.
A best-selling book is one that lots and lots of people buy.
Abound means there are lots of something. Authors abound means many authors were there.
The National Book Award is a famous prize for writers. A finalist is one of the last few writers who could win.
Avatar: Last Airbender is a TV show about a boy who can control the wind and other parts of nature.
A gig is a job. Here, it means the job of writing the books.
An analysis is a close look at something to understand it. He wrote down his thoughts about each episode.
A thread is a string of short posts online, one after another.
Strolling means walking slowly and happily.
Artist Alley is a part of Comic Con. Artists sit at tables and sell and sign their art.
Teen Titans is a series about young superheroes who work as a team.
To voice a character means to speak as that character in a cartoon.
A graphic novel is a long story told with pictures and words, like a comic book.
A panel is a group of people who sit on a stage and talk to an audience.
A coauthor writes a book together with someone else.
Aries is how the article spells Ares. Ares is the Greek god of war.
Underwhelming means not very exciting or not very special.
To be in someone's shadow means people notice the other person more than you.
To prove yourself means to show everyone you can do something well.
Origins means how something first began.
Collaborators are people who work together on something.
The Lightning Thief is the first Percy Jackson book.
Conversational means like a friendly chat.
Beloved means loved very much by many people.
A novelist is a person who writes long made-up stories.
A scoop is a secret bit of news you get before other people.
